notes.merge: Do not edit this fragment into package.json from the logs feature agent. Add onView:axis.logs to activationEvents. Insert the webview into contributes.views.axis-panel immediately after axis.symbols (Symbols). If axis.symbols is not merged yet, place axis.logs directly after axis.profiler so the final order is Profiler, Symbols, Logs. Name is Logs. type webview. retainContextWhenHidden false. Add compile:webview:logs and append && npm run compile:webview:logs to the existing compile:webview script. Append && tsc -p webview/logs/tsconfig.json --noEmit to the existing check script. Paste the script strings from this fragment only if they still match package.json plus logs.
notes.wiring: Call registerLogsPanel(context, resultsStore) from activate after registerProfilerView. Import it from ./views/logs-panel. window.registerWebviewViewProvider('axis.logs', provider, { webviewOptions: { retainContextWhenHidden: false } }) is inside registerLogsPanel. Do not edit extension.ts from the logs feature agent.
notes.assets: Webview loads dist/webview/logs/main.js + main.css (Vite IIFE AxisLogsWebview, outDir dist/webview/logs, clone of profiler).
notes.vscodeignore: After the last dist/webview whitelist block, add the four logs lines from vscodeignore in this fragment, in that order: un-ignore the directory, ignore its contents, then un-ignore main.js and main.css. Same pattern as dist/webview/profiler/.
notes.coverage: Add 'views/logs-panel.ts' to EXCLUDE in scripts/check-coverage.mjs (next to views/profiler-panel.ts). The panel is a vscode shim. Do not EXCLUDE views/logs-messages.ts or views/logs-html.ts — they stay on the pure-host 100% line gate.
notes.protocol: Host posts local { type: 'logs.set', rows, runId, status }. Webview posts { type: 'logs.ready' }, { type: 'logs.reveal', line }, and may post { type: 'logs.filter', level }. Filter is client-side; the host ignores logs.filter and only posts rows. logs.reveal with a positive integer line reveals that line in the active Pine editor (languageId pinescript, pine, or pyne). If no Pine editor is active, show an information message — do not call showTextDocument. Do NOT add logs.set / logs.ready / logs.reveal / logs.filter to axis.webview.v1 ALL_MESSAGE_TYPES. Rows come from record.logs, record.meta.logs, record.diagnostics, record.meta.diagnostics, and a single record.error. Another agent may add optional logs and diagnostics on RunResultRecord; logsFromRun already reads an unknown record.
notes.electron: When merging, add axis.logs (type webview, name Logs, retainContextWhenHidden false) to the axis-panel view list after Symbols (or after axis.profiler if Symbols is not in the list yet) and onView:axis.logs to activationEvents.
